description: Create a fast, compact, source-linked company snapshot from a public company website. One search of the company's own pages returns the name, what the company does, offerings, headquarters and size only when a retrieved page states them, 3 to 5 source URLs, and confidence. For cheap agent lookups and first-pass screening. Public pages only. Refuses private-person dossiers and does not invent citations. Not a substitute for the full company intelligence report and not for high-stakes automated decisions. Price: $0.03 USDC. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired tool result and does not run the tool. Payment is verified and settled before the tool runs.

website.description: Public company website or domain, such as https://example.com.
